ValidationRule.description: Venkat: Created as part of NZC Phase 3 Implementation Purpose: To restrict the Data Modeller to update the status of an system generated energy use records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsSystemGeneratedRecord = TRUE, ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c ,"Data Modeller"), ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Created")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Status Field.
